events.summary: Speaker A set the project aim: a new remote control that is original, trendy and user-friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: it needs to be original, trendy and user-friendly

events.summary: Speaker A split the project into three parts: functional, conceptual and detailed design, each with individual work followed by a group meeting.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we're gonna divide us up into three compa three parts

events.summary: Speaker A said the product would sell for about 25 EUR.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we'd like to sell it for about twenty five Euro

events.summary: Speaker A gave the profit aim from sales as 15000000 EUR.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: profit aim of um fifteen million Euro um from our sales

events.summary: Speaker A said each unit must be produced for a maximum of 12.50 EUR to reach the profit aim.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: be able to produce each one at a maximum of twelve fifty Euro

events.summary: Speaker D objected to combining many devices into one remote because it causes multimedia overload.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: I don't know if I necessarily like that 'cause I feel like you end up with multimedia overload

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a device to help find a lost remote.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: Some sort of like device to help you find it.

events.summary: Speaker B proposed that the remote work without the user moving it around to aim the infra-red signal.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: is if you are not um sort of moving it around to get it to work with the infra-red

events.summary: Speaker B said the remote should have few buttons and buttons that are not too small.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: that there's not too many buttons, they are not too small

events.summary: Speaker A proposed a lithium battery, which would last much longer than double A batteries.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we could use like a lithium battery um that would last a lot longer

events.summary: Speaker B proposed a remote with only the major buttons that work for everything.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: just has your major buttons for that work for everything

events.summary: Speaker D proposed grouping buttons by device in separate areas instead of putting all power buttons together.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: And maybe that spatially divides it, so it's like if you're looki

events.summary: Speaker B proposed saving the more complicated functions for separate remotes that are not needed every day.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: if you'd save the more complicated functions maybe for separate remotes

events.summary: Speaker A proposed one remote with the main functions (on, off, channel, volume) and a second remote for the special functions.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: maybe have like one remote that has the main functions on, off, channel changing, volume

events.summary: Speaker A committed to look into whether video recorder functions can be included on the remote.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: It's a good question. Um. I'll look into that.

events.summary: Speaker D proposed that the remote is just for a television, as a new product.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: I think it's just T_V_, I mean, if it if we're taking it just new product

events.summary: Speaker C proposed assuming the remote only controls a television, and the group went ahead on that basis.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: we should maybe we should assume that i t it's just a television that we're wanting to control

events.summary: Speaker C said it would be nice to have play, record and stop buttons for the video recorder, unsure if that works technologically.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: it would be nice to have playing and record and stop buttons on it

events.summary: Speaker B said buttons must be large, since older or less coordinated users cannot press small buttons.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: it's really quite important that you are not pressing a small like teeny mobiles phone size buttons

events.summary: Speaker A committed to put together the agenda for the next meeting.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: I haven't gotten an agenda yet, um I'll put that together.

events.summary: Speaker A committed to type up the meeting minutes and email them to everyone.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: I'll type up mi minutes and probably email those out to all of you.

events.summary: Speaker A agreed to email the slides to Speaker C.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: I'll just attach it to an email.
